purpose: Authorize one bounded Russia stablecoin-regulation guide update after the July 2026 Russian crypto-market law and Bank of Russia implementation work, while preserving canonical Market Access and Evidence boundaries.

reviewed_claims.nonqualified_access: most liquid cryptocurrencies after testing, up to RUB 300000 per year via one intermediary
reviewed_claims.qualified_access: purchase and sale of cryptocurrencies after testing without the nonqualified amount limit
reviewed_claims.foreign_stablecoin_scope: Bank of Russia states that cryptocurrency requirements also apply to foreign stablecoins
reviewed_claims.domestic_payment_boundary: cryptocurrency payments within Russia remain prohibited
reviewed_claims.organized_trading: Bank of Russia has drafted regulations for organised trading in digital currencies and digital rights
reviewed_claims.btc_eth_usdt_wording: Bank of Russia First Deputy Governor Vladimir Chistyukhin told RBC on 2026-06-04 that Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT are the three currencies that currently meet the initial principles for non-qualified-investor access; this is not to be rendered as a permanent statutory whitelist

required_public_outcomes: Russia guide distinguishes enacted framework from specific-token interview commentary
USDT is identified only with source-qualified wording and not as a permanent legal whitelist
global comparison reflects the 2026-09-01 regulated trading framework and domestic-payment prohibition

market_access_v1_decision.reason: Market Access Record v1 requires a named platform/service and function-scoped evidence. The reviewed Russia-wide legal framework does not by itself establish a provider-scoped canonical access observation.

prohibited: add or modify canonical Market Access Records
add canonical Evidence or Evidence Relations
state that Russia permanently whitelisted exactly BTC ETH and USDT
state that USDT is universally available to all Russian users or on all Russian exchanges
infer provider-level deposit withdrawal or external-wallet-transfer support
ranking scoring recommendation or safety framing
